SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(item_count) as avg_of_counts
FROM (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    COUNT(*) as item_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 
      THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL    -- the rows returned are: avg_of_ratios = 2.218019050782608, avg_of_counts = 1.3636363636363635
